githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.6 Beta 6 adds on-device translation for messages and drafts, friend and server nicknames, threads in the channel sidebar, and an app-wide Interface size setting. It also animates sent messages in the bubble style, fixes several bubble layout problems, makes server tags open server profile cards, and improves links, video previews and the Frequently Used emoji list.

## On-device translation

- Added optional translation for messages and drafts using Apple's on-device Translation framework. It is off by default and turned on in Settings → Features, with separate target languages for messages and drafts.
- Added Translate Message to translate a message inline, then show the original or copy the translation.
- Added Translate Draft to the composer's + menu and as a keyboard shortcut you can customize. Edits to a translated draft are kept when switching back, the translation is a separate Undo step, and drafts are never sent automatically.
- Kept mentions, links, emoji, code and Discord formatting out of translation so they arrive unchanged, and kept original and translated spoilers hidden until revealed.

## Message bubbles

- Added an animation in the bubble message style that carries a sent message from the composer into the timeline, including attachments, GIFs, stickers and polls. The standard style and Reduce Motion are unchanged.
- Fixed replies in the bubble style by placing the quoted message beside its bubble, on the bubble's side, with a connector into the bubble.
- Fixed editing in the bubble style so the editor replaces the bubble instead of overlapping it and clipping text.
- Fixed oversized media bubbles, avatars overlapping the previous message, and a visible seam where hover highlights met the bubble tail.
- Aligned reactions with outgoing bubbles and showed emoji-only and sticker-only messages without a bubble fill.
- Kept mention pills, labels and channel icons readable in outgoing bubbles.

## Nicknames and server tags

- Added Add Friend Nickname and Change Friend Nickname. Friend nicknames appear in DMs and group DMs and stay in sync with other Discord clients.
- Added Change Nickname for other server members, following Discord's owner, permission and role-hierarchy rules.
- Changed right-clicking yourself in a server to open your per-server profile.
- Added server tags to the message timeline and member list. Clicking a tag opens the server's profile card, with Go to Server for joined servers and Join for discoverable ones.
- Added Accessibility → Disable Cosmetics → Server tags to hide everyone's server tags locally.

## Threads and direct messages

- Added joined threads beneath their parent channels in the sidebar, following Discord's rules for showing recent, pinned, unread and mentioned threads, with native thread menus where permitted.
- Added live member lists for threads and forum posts opened full width.
- Made read DMs less prominent than unread ones and dimmed muted conversations while they are not selected. VoiceOver now announces muted conversations.
- Changed DM selection to a neutral gray highlight and kept keyboard navigation working in the DM sidebar.

## Links, attachments and media

- Added a built-in list of trusted domains for well-known services, along with wildcard rules such as `*.example.com`. Existing custom domains are preserved, and resetting Privacy & Safety restores the built-in list.
- Kept Discord attachment links showing their full URL and refreshed expired or soon-to-expire attachment links before opening them.
- Fixed image embeds that were hidden when Discord supplied the image only as a thumbnail.
- Added video poster frames to forum post cards, forwarded-message previews, the media viewer's thumbnail strip, app message media galleries, and the composer's attachment tray.

## Interface and emoji

- Added an Interface size setting that scales text, icons and controls throughout SakuraCord, with menu commands and keyboard shortcuts to increase, decrease or reset it. Message density remains a separate setting.
- Fixed the Frequently Used emoji section not updating. It now follows Discord's ordering, counts emoji used in messages and reactions, and syncs with other Discord clients.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.6-Beta-5...v0.1.6-Beta-6](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.6-Beta-5...v0.1.6-Beta-6)
discordAnnouncement:
**On-device translation, nicknames, and sidebar threads 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Translate messages and drafts on-device with Apple's Translation framework, keeping mentions, links, emoji, and code intact.
- Give friends nicknames, and change server members' nicknames where Discord allows it.
- Joined threads now appear under their channels in the sidebar, and full-width threads show live member lists.
- A new Interface size setting scales text, icons, and controls throughout the app.
- In bubble style, sent messages now animate out of the composer, and replies, editing, media sizing and reactions have been fixed.
- Server tags open server profile cards, Frequently Used emoji sync with Discord, and common sites are trusted by default.
